_comment: Each gate records its decision: an engineering PASS or FAIL carries decision {kind, recordedBy, recordedAt, recordCommit}; a gate that only a founder, accountant or counsel can close carries requiredApprover and an approval block {by, role, at, reference} that stays empty until that person decides in writing, and it can be PASS only with that block complete and with every config/evidence-manifest.json record of the gate verified (tests/release-gates.test.mjs). Release gates for CAI-L4-CI-001 that need a person, a tenant or an approval, and so cannot be decided by scripts/release/certify-release.mjs alone. Each gate has one status: PASS (evidenced; 'evidence' says where), FAIL, BLOCKED (cannot be run yet; 'blockedBy' says why), or REQUIRES FOUNDER APPROVAL. A status changes only when the evidence named here exists. The certifier prints these beside the gates it checks itself; it never upgrades one.
